user.title: IoTaWatt Plus
user.description: IP address or hostname of the IoTaWatt on your network.

data.deadband: Minimum change to store a value

data_description.scan_interval: How often the IoTaWatt is polled for power (2–60 s). Automations always see the latest value.
data_description.energy_interval: How often the kWh totals computed by the IoTaWatt are read.
data_description.device_interval: How often firmware, Wi-Fi and uptime are read.
data_description.request_timeout: Maximum wait for each request before the sensors become unavailable.
data_description.deadband: A new power state is only stored when it changes at least this much. Greatly reduces database size.
data_description.max_age: The value is stored at least this often even if unchanged.
data_description.grid_series: Signed channel: positive = importing, negative = exporting.
data_description.surplus_windows: Seconds, comma separated. One 'surplus average' sensor is created per window (e.g. 30, 60, 300).
data_description.channels: Inputs and outputs to create sensors for. Leave empty for all.

error.no_series: The IoTaWatt has no inputs or outputs configured.
error.bad_windows: Enter at least one window in seconds between 1 and 3600, comma separated.
